searchText: Hi all! I got a questions about light nodes (geth) and the Great Merge. I see `GetPayloadV1` is the only RPC call unsupported by les. Is it impossible to implement or will be implemented later? I can imagine `GetPayloadV1` requires mempool only so it should be doable, but I might be easily mistaken? https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/blob/master/les/catalyst/api.go#L99-L102= LES is still on some older version of the engine api Since the engine api changed so rapidly I opted to not update LES for it But yes we can not have GetPayloadV1 in LES, not because of the txpool, but because creating a block requires the state (which is not available on a light nocde) With PBS it might be possible to implement GetPayload on a light node in the future fyi there will be support for sepolia from beaconcha.in ETH devs, when looking to the future, should be mindful of the network hashrate. The price action has been very brutal, and have lost quite a lot over the last two weeks. So when the mainnet merge is to come, may need to consider setting a shorter TTD than you normally would lest the delay from even further hashrate drops becomes a confounding factor. I know Tim has talked about this before. Have we considered increasing the block rewards to keep the hashrate high? I don't know how naive this sounds, but say scaling the block rewards with bomb delay times so as to encourage consistent hashrate in the late Aug - early Oct window. or a big reward for mining the TRANSITION_BLOCK There is nothing "special" about the transition block, nor is there logic in the issuance calculations to identify it there can be many candidate transition blocks, and having a larger reward for it will just mean a ton of uncles right at the merge
